date: Nov 23, 2026 · Week 3 / Day 1 · Upward communication and influence

cards.title: Lead with the consequence
cards.question: PCIe Gen5 margin fell 0.8 dB, but root cause is open. What does your director need first?
cards.selfCheck: State release exposure and decision deadline before waveforms. Distinguish observed margin loss from the unconfirmed cause; request one action.
cards.prompt: Role-play my director. Give me a PCIe margin problem and critique my 20-second risk-first update for consequence, confidence, ask and timing.

cards.title: Certain data, uncertain cause
cards.question: Bench TDR repeatedly shows a dip absent from EM. How do you avoid sounding either alarmist or dismissive?
cards.selfCheck: Say what is repeatable, what remains a hypothesis, and what measurement could separate fixture from board effects. Give a checkpoint, not a vague promise.
cards.prompt: Coach me to deliver a 30-second EM/TDR mismatch update using precise confidence language; challenge any unsupported certainty.

cards.title: Win the shared objective
cards.question: Layout resists a PCIe reroute that could protect margin but threatens placement closure. How do you gain traction?
cards.selfCheck: Frame the common release goal and quantify both risks. Propose a bounded experiment with a decision owner and cutoff, rather than issuing a demand.
cards.prompt: Role-play a resistant layout lead. Practice persuading with a shared goal, bounded PCIe tradeoff and explicit decision deadline.

cards.title: Escalate the blocked decision
cards.question: A PDN resonance fix spans VRM, package and PCB, and no team can approve the system tradeoff. What do you escalate?
cards.selfCheck: Escalate the cross-team decision, impact and options—not a complaint about people. Recommend an accountable integrator and a date for resolution.
cards.prompt: Act as a busy hardware director. Make me present a PDN resonance escalation in 25 seconds with options, recommendation and ownership ask.

cards.title: Thirty seconds, one ask
cards.question: Before tomorrow's release review, crosstalk is 3 dB over target. Give your VP a decision-ready update.
cards.selfCheck: Use Week 1 risk-first visibility and Week 2 decision framing: consequence, evidence/confidence, recommended path, owner and checkpoint. Keep it under 30 seconds.
cards.prompt: Give me a realistic 3 dB NEXT miss near layout freeze. Score my 30-second VP brief on risk-first clarity, calibrated uncertainty and a single decision ask.
